newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - CVRD still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CVRD still a buy.

text.p: -- Flemings Research said in a report it was reiterating its long-term buy rating on Brazilian state-owned mining firm Companhia Vale do Rio Doce preferred stock.
-- It said earnings of 340 million reais under the inflation-adjusted accounting method rose strongly in the fourth quarter due to tax and accounting adjustements.
-- "The privatization process is now under way, and bidding for the control company will be held at the end of the next month," it said.
-- Vale preferred shares were trading at 25 reais, off 0.79 percent.
